review.note: Rewritten as data from the old lesson (jawwid-lessons @ c231532 arabic/lesson-3/lib/arabicData.ts, read as text, never built or run). Each unit is a letter carrying one haraka; a word belongs to it only if that letter carries that haraka (the one rule, with its mark). Words whose letter does not carry the vowel are left out and listed (decision B); words whose last letter carries the lesson's vowel keep it as a held final-mark exception (decision A). Every added mark is held (ADDED TASHKEEL).
